editorial.blurb: The Bougie Foodie brings thoughtfully crafted desserts to Fulton Market that rival the city's most celebrated sweet spots.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early and grab a warm chocolate chip cookie straight from the case—reviewers rave about the gooey texture and exceptional chocolate chips, and they compare them favorably to Levain's. Don't skip the cinnamon roll and bread pudding either.

topDishes.note: Warm, gooey, and better-than-Levain according to fans
Melts in your mouth, a must-try
